identity.name: SHRIRAM PROPERTIES LTD
identity.industry: Residential Real Estate Development / Mid-Market Premium (Bangalore-Chennai-Kolkata-Pune)

summary.oneLiner: Despite Q2FY26 revenue and profit being muted due to BBMP regulatory paralysis delaying OC/eKhata approvals (deferring INR 420cr revenue), operational KPIs remained strong with 39% QoQ sales growth and 30% YoY handovers; the normalization of approvals since October has unlocked a highly visible H2 revenue recognition pipeline of INR 1,000cr+ and 2,800+ unit handovers, positioning the company to exceed FY26 guidance and accelerate toward its Mission 1234 target of INR 5,000cr+ pending recognition by FY28.

one-line thesis: Despite Q2FY26 revenue and profit being muted due to BBMP regulatory paralysis delaying OC/eKhata approvals (deferring INR 420cr revenue), operational KPIs remained strong with 39% QoQ sales growth and 30% YoY handovers; the normalization of approvals since October has unlocked a highly visible H2 revenue recognition pipeline of INR 1,000cr+ and 2,800+ unit handovers, positioning the company to exceed FY26 guidance and accelerate toward its Mission 1234 target of INR 5,000cr+ pending recognition by FY28.
financial scorecard: revenue: 229cr (YoY +48%) - muted by deferred recognition; EBITDA/margin: 23.3cr (YoY +73%), margin 10.2% - stable gross margin at 32% but EBITDA compressed by overhead absorption; PAT (rptd): 8.6cr (vs loss in Q2FY25); PAT (normalized): ~25-30cr estimated (if deferred revenue recognized); order book: 2.5M+ sq.ft. (INR 1,128cr) ready for handover in H2; net debt: 407cr (Net Debt/Equity 0.29x) - no distortions, healthy balance sheet
guidance: revenue growth: >1,100cr H2 (targeting ~1,800cr full year); margin: 9-11% PAT margin target by FY26; order inflow: 5-6 new projects (6M+ sq.ft.) expected in H2; capex/commissioning: Capex aligned with new project launches; commissioning of 2,800+ units in H2
order book & pipeline: 2,800+ units (2.5M+ sq.ft., INR 1,128cr GDV) ready for handover in H2FY26; additional 2.5M sq.ft. under active evaluation; total pending revenue recognition: INR 5,000cr+ by FY28
segment / subsidiary detail: Bangalore: 80% sell-through on Code Name The One (0.5M sq.ft.); Chennai: new launches underway; Kolkata: Springfield Phase 2 at 43% sold; Pune: Code Name Superstar at 48% sold; JV/JDA projects contributed 56% of Q2 handovers
growth verticals / optionality: 5-6 new projects (6M+ sq.ft.) in advanced diligence; 20M+ sq.ft. in active pipeline; 313-acre freehold land in Kolkata (130 acres developable) with potential for monetization or development; Mission 1234 targets 30-35M sq.ft. delivery by FY28
margins & cost dynamics: Gross margin stable at 32%; EBITDA margin compressed temporarily by overhead absorption due to deferred revenue; construction cost inflation offset by steady pricing (5-8% annual hikes); portfolio upgrade from <5k/sq.ft. to 6.5k-7k/sq.ft. mid-market avg. supports margin expansion
capex / expansion: Capex funded via short-term debt for land acquisition and project launches; INR 143cr invested in new BD projects in H1; no land bank, all land acquired just-in-time; capex aligned with launch cadence
capital allocation: Prioritizing debt reduction (net debt/equity 0.29x); funding new project acquisitions via debt (short-term); reinvesting cash flow into pipeline expansion; potential future monetization of Kolkata land (313 acres) to unlock value
risks & watch-items: Regulatory volatility (BBMP transition, eKhata delays); litigation risk on Kolkata land (INR 259cr provision, pending in High Court); execution risk on accelerated launch cadence; market sentiment sensitivity in regional markets
management quality / tone: Confident, resilient, and forward-looking; acknowledged Q2 disruption as temporary and external; emphasized operational strength, normalized approvals, and robust H2 visibility; reiterated FY26 guidance and Mission 1234; tone suggests strong belief in execution capability and market demand
non-obvious takeaways: INR 259cr contingent liability on Kolkata land is nearly resolved (Q2 provision dropped to INR 1.7cr); 85% of inventory is sold, meaning most 'inventory' is WIP; Kolkata land (313 acres) is undervalued by market with 130 acres developable; 1/4th of sales driven by referrals, indicating strong brand loyalty

themes.title: Real-estate up-cycle - premium housing & redevelopment
themes.need: The residential up-cycle is now presales-led with a visible margin cost. SOBHA posted its highest-ever presales at INR 3,656cr (+76% YoY, 2.34 msf at an average INR 15,655/sqft, NCR at a record INR 1,384cr) and guided FY27 presales at +30% or better - but reported EBITDA is still only ~9.7%, guided to 17-20% only by exit-Q4, and forthcoming-project marginal cash flow was cut from ~INR 86bn to INR 68.3bn on a heavier joint-development mix. SUNTECK booked INR 787cr of presales (+20%) with ZERO launches in the quarter, with aspirational-luxury (Naigaon/Kalyan) at 21% of presales 'picking up because of the lower interest rate' - the first sign the rate-elastic end is turning on demand rather than inventory release. DLF's FY26 bookings of INR20,143cr and 50mn sq ft of rental at 95% occupancy anchor the annuity leg; LODHA/GODREJPROP/PRESTIGE-tier and MMR redevelopers (RUSTOMJEE, KALPATARU, RAYMONDREL, MANINFRA, SURAJEST) ride premiumization; PHOENIXLTD/EMBDL on mixed-use.
themes.driver: SOBHA's exit-Q4 margin ramp from ~9.7% to 17-20% is the falsifiable claim (JD-heavy growth structurally lowers marginal margins); rate-elastic aspirational absorption (SUNTECK); FY27 launch-pipeline execution and festive booking momentum.
